name: Lauren Spoors
bio:
Lauren Spoors is a masterful tattoo artist specializing in traditional and illustrative styles, ensuring every piece is executed with precision and artistry. As a co-owner of Wishbone Tattoo Studio in Ouseburn, Newcastle Upon Tyne, Lauren maintains the highest standards of cleanliness, fostering a sterile environment for both the safety and comfort of clients. Dedicated to her craft and the well-being of her customers, she operates on an appointment-only basis to ensure each tattoo receives the attention it deserves.
